summary: game_dialogs 004 (Crusade): recreate the dialog; keep the icons
author: pm
body:
The user, 2026-11-25, sheet by sheet: "001 - The kit should have all of these" (HH-0091); "002 - We can recreate those too"; "003 - Should already exist minus the glowing + - buttons - which we can add to the kit and recreate the rest"; "004 - The dialog can go as we can recreate it - but the rest can stay."; "005 - that's fine"; "006 - We can recreate that as well"; "010 - we can remove this entirely since the kit already includes that too".

Sheet 004 (InterfaceNdCrusade) holds the crusade dialog plus icons used by commander, constructor, guide map and map dialogs (as of 2026-11-25). User: "004 - The dialog can go as we can recreate it - but the rest can stay." Recreate the dialog background with the kit and stop drawing those frames; the icon frames stay in the sheet. List the dropped frames for HH-0079 (they become unused frames in a live sheet).

**Done when:** every live use draws from the kit at the same place and with the same look, the sheet's retired frames are no longer loaded, retired images are archived byte-identical to working/archive/interface/game_dialogs/ with empty manifest placeholders, both builds are clean, and in-client screenshots of each affected dialog are attached.

**Closed, 2026-11-25:** already delivered by HH-0066 batch 7 (commit 56846e2b): the crusade dialog background is drawn at runtime from the kit (draw_crusade_frame), and sheet 004 frame 0 is no longer drawn. Frames 0, 22 and 23 are unused and go to HH-0079. The sheet stays loaded for its icons. Not seen in a running client: nothing can start crusade mode in a test build; a composite from the real kit atlas is at build/screenshots/hh0095_composite_before_after.png.

comments.author: pm
comments.body: User, 2026-11-25: "Those all can be runtime generated on the base form - the buttons just need added to the kit". So: the item-upgrade slot panel (002 frame 3), the sheet 003 pieces and the crusade dialog background are built at runtime from the kit's base form. The glowing +/- (003 frames 5/6) become new panel-kit pieces.

comments.author: client
comments.body:
Editor, 2026-11-25: no code change was needed; awaiting PM review.

- The crusade dialog background is already built at runtime from the kit. `IDialogBox::draw_crusade_frame` (dialog_box.cpp) has drawn it since HH-0066 batch 7 (56846e2b): a 311x407 gold_box kit frame, a title, and the standard inset status strip. It is used by the commander, constructor and soldier dialogs. That commit removed the last draw of sheet 004 frame 0.
- I tallied every live sheet 004 draw in sources/client (draw_new_dialog_box and m_sprite[InterfaceNdCrusade]->draw). Frames in use: 1-21 and 24-43, meaning the icon buttons, the frame-21 middleland map, and the map markers 36-43 (also drawn by the guide map, the map dialog and the world crusade markers). The sheet stays loaded.
- **Dropped frames for HH-0079 (unused frames in a live sheet): 0, 22, 23.**
  - 0: the old 311x373 dialog background (rect 2,2).
  - 22 and 23: the same 266x10 strip at rect 26,382, never drawn.
- No manifest, staged-art, load or sprite_id change: the sheet is live and frames are read by index.
- Build: not run; no source changed.
- Capture: build/screenshots/hh0095_composite_before_after.png, a labelled PIL COMPOSITE (old frame 0 + map vs the kit frame + map), not an in-client capture. The crusade dialogs need crusade mode, and the client has no debug path to it (no tester or GM command to start a crusade). Unverified in-client.
